method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation of the Land Tax Assessment Act 2002 (No. 52 of 2002), mrdoc 49123 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49123.txt; no compilation number or date stated; includes the Land Tax Assessment Amendment (Build-to-Rent) Act 2026 (No. 6 of 2026). Rates: Land Tax Act 2002 (No. 51 of 2002) s 5 Table 11 (2015/16 and subsequent years), mrdoc 28122 retrieved 2026-09-07, deposited at ../../../land-tax-act-2002/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_28122.txt, compilation table ending with the Land Tax Amendment Act 2015 (No. 24 of 2015). The capped-value prescribed percentage (Glossary cl 6(4)) is set by regulations not deposited: an input.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the home owner (and the owner of other land), for the WA lives (Chloe c055; Daniel d055, d084): ss 5, 6(1) (due on the 49th day); ss 7(1), 7(4), 8(3) (owner at midnight on 30 June before the assessment year; joint and several; vendor until the buyer has possession); s 9A ($5,000); ss 10, 11(1), 12(1), 12(3) (rate on aggregated taxable value; joint land separate); ss 17, 18 (whole and partial exemption); s 20(3)-(5) (60 days to appeal; tax still payable); s 20A(4); s 21 (private residence exemption: individual, spouses, 2-year de facto partners, guarantor co-owners; trusts and companies excluded; partial exemption for other co-owners an inference); s 23 (one year after death); ss 24, 24A (building a home, 1 and 2 years); s 26A (disabled relative); s 26B (owner in full-time care); s 27 (moving between 2 homes); s 40 ($10,000 for war widows); Glossary cl 1 definitions and cl 6 (taxable value; prescribed percentage an input); Land Tax Act 2002 s 5 Table 11 as a table. Not encoded: subdivision rules, ss 13, 16, 20(1), 22, 23A, 25, 25A, 26, 27A, 28, 28F-28K, Divisions 3-5 except s 40, s 45A, earlier rate tables, the Taxation Administration Act 2003.
seat: the home owner (and the owner of other land)
